title.zh-CN: 生成式推荐进入深水区：2026 前沿第二季
title.en: Generative Recommendation in Deep Water: The 2026 Frontier

subtitle.zh-CN: 从可学习 Semantic ID、级联推理与连续 Token，到分页推荐、广告部署和泛化审计
subtitle.en: From learnable Semantic IDs, cascaded reasoning, and continuous tokens to page generation, advertising deployment, and generalization audits

question.zh-CN: 当模型已经会生成商品之后，ID 怎样学习、偏差怎样传播、结果怎样上线、能力又该怎样被证明？
question.en: Once a model can generate items, how should IDs learn, how does bias propagate, how can the system ship, and how do we prove the capability is real?

description.zh-CN: 先让推荐损失改写商品语言，再处理自回归前缀带来的级联偏差。
description.en: Let recommendation loss reshape the item language, then confront cascading bias in autoregressive prefixes.

description.zh-CN: 质疑离散 SID 的必然性，并把推荐输出从已有商品扩展到新内容。
description.en: Question whether discrete SIDs are necessary and extend outputs from catalog items to newly generated content.

description.zh-CN: 从整页生成、广告主链路，到拆开“记忆”和“泛化”的评估幻觉。
description.en: Move from page generation and advertising pipelines to separating memorization from genuine generalization.

title.zh-CN: Tokenizer 终于能听见推荐损失
title.en: The Tokenizer Can Finally Hear Recommendation Loss

role.zh-CN: 让 Semantic ID 可微并接受下游梯度，同时用探索与不确定性衰减避免 codebook 塌缩。
role.en: Make Semantic IDs differentiable and trainable by downstream gradients while using exploration and uncertainty decay to prevent codebook collapse.

title.zh-CN: 生成越深，偏差可能越大
title.en: The Deeper the Generation, the Larger the Bias Can Grow

role.zh-CN: 把逐 token 解码解释为级联排序，用渐进历史和查询锚定的并行推理抑制前缀错误。
role.en: Interpret token decoding as cascaded ranking and use progressive history plus query-anchored parallel reasoning to limit prefix errors.

title.zh-CN: Semantic ID 不是唯一答案
title.en: Semantic IDs Are Not the Only Answer

role.zh-CN: 取消离散量化，用连续 Token 与扩散模型生成偏好向量，再映射回真实商品。
role.en: Remove discrete quantization, generate preference vectors with continuous tokens and diffusion, then map them back to real items.

title.zh-CN: 推荐系统开始生成商品
title.en: The Recommender Starts Generating the Product

role.zh-CN: 用双扩散同时生成服装图像与结构化描述，把推荐从选择库存推进到个性化设计。
role.en: Use dual diffusion to generate both fashion images and structured descriptions, moving recommendation from catalog selection toward personalized design.

title.zh-CN: 下一件商品不够，模型要生成整页
title.en: One Next Item Is Not Enough: Generate the Whole Page

role.zh-CN: 以页面为训练单位，压缩长历史，并用页面级强化学习对齐复杂偏好。
role.en: Train at page level, compress long histories, and align complex preferences with page-level reinforcement learning.

title.zh-CN: 生成式推荐进入广告主链路
title.en: Generative Recommendation Enters the Advertising Mainline

role.zh-CN: 把商业价值写进广告 Semantic ID、列表奖励与低延迟解码，展示四亿用户规模的部署证据。
role.en: Encode business value into advertising Semantic IDs, list rewards, and low-latency decoding, with deployment evidence at hundreds of millions of users.

episodes.paper: How Well Does Generative Recommendation Generalize?

title.zh-CN: Semantic ID 真的更会泛化吗？
title.en: Do Semantic IDs Really Generalize Better?

role.zh-CN: 把测试样本拆成记忆型与组合泛化型，揭开总体 NDCG 背后的能力错觉。
role.en: Split test cases into memorization and compositional-generalization regimes to expose what aggregate NDCG can hide.
